tex_content.source:
\begin{definition}[Auxiliary integral $A(t)$]
\label{def:a-function-integral}
For fixed $t'$, set
\[
A(t)=\int_{t'}^t\frac12R_{\min}(s)\,ds.
\]
\end{definition}

\begin{claim}[Explicit formula for $w_{a,t'}$]
